title: Occlusion without a guard in a Dear ImGui app
blurb: An ImGui window dragged over a DOM field must stop the field taking the pointer. Nine routes are tried: a script guard, canvasClip, CSS clip-path and mask, a blocker element, inert, and a plain element above the canvas.
question: Can the geometry given to updateElementGeometry() say that an ImGui window covers a DOM field, so that no script has to decide it at event time?
result: Not with canvasClip, which is one rectangle. Yes with an empty blocker element placed last, and with CSS clip-path on the field at the cost of one texture upload per move.
